subject: kolega-code
title: ASK-mode floor is absent under delegation: sub-agents and workflow fan-out workers hardcode AUTO + auto-allow, and the delegation tools themselves carry no permission kind
one_why: A model in an interactive ASK session can launder an unapprovable command through an unattended AUTO sub-agent; unlike the already-filed compound-string leak (kolega-code-3) this bypasses the chokepoint structurally, not textually, and no deny-rule or worker jail exists beneath it - it is the concrete reason safety cannot rise to 7.

subject: kolega-code
title: 172k test-LOC claim inflated ~40% by shipped skill package-data and benchmark vendored trees; real property corps ~121k/416 files
evidence: kolega_code/_bundled_skills (30,575 py LOC, 23,527 shipped tools); benchmarks/edit_tools/fixtures/snapshots/click-b67832c2167e (13,578 LOC); tests/ 121,092 LOC
one_why: Third instance of the census-inflation family (deepagents tau2 fixtures, auto-code-rover results blobs) with a new mechanism - wheel-bundled package data counted as tests; scored against the measured 121k the 8-rung still holds, but any future subject whose rung depends on the difference needs the census glob split from product package data.

subject: kolega-code
title: Content-addressed FIFO resume journal: sha1 cache_key over semantically-significant call inputs, identical-key calls consumed in original issue order, replayed calls re-recorded so resume-of-a-resume replays exactly
one_why: Strongest occupant of the seeded concept (x13): labels excluded from the key so renaming a step does not bust its cache, FIFO handles pipeline completion-order drift, and None values stay distinguishable from cache misses - a replay contract more rigorous than cline's event-log journal, hotdog-fit for fan-out workflow resume.

subject: kolega-code
title: Slow and integration tiers are excluded from every CI workflow: run_tests.sh gates on -m "not slow" and no workflow passes --all
evidence: run_tests.sh:57; .github/workflows/ci.yml:114-121 (no --all/--slow anywhere in ci.yml, codeql.yml, release.yml)
one_why: CI's green only proves the fast suite; the marked integration tier is instrumented but never enforced, so verification credit must be taken from the CI-run subset - on this subject the bulk is fast (rung unchanged at 8), but the pattern sinks thinner subjects and belongs with the instrumented-but-unenforced family (forge, deepagents evals.yml).
